description: NHFLOW 2D: a concrete wall (fix base, 0.4 m) holds a 0.3 m water column on the dry bed. The water stays at rest and the wall carries the hydrostatic load (4.41 N on the 1 cm slice).
covers: fem_coupling::start_nhflow (Z 30 with A 10 5): sigma-grid kernel sampling and forcing of U,V,W / UH,VH,WH
cells inside the structure marked solid (p->DF -1) and no continuity flux through them (d->solid_flux, nhflow_solid_flux)
probed pressure: non-hydrostatic P plus hydrostatic pressure of the local free surface, settling under the initial water
